challengers.baseline: fixed L2 logistic regression, C=1.0, lbfgs, no class weighting
challengers.smooth_nonlinear: baseline plus alpha, beta, alpha^2, beta^2, alpha*beta

claim: Cusp-derived geometry adds out-of-sample crash-risk information beyond a fixed War Room baseline using the same observable inputs.

cusp_model.alpha: linear in three frozen normal-factor controls plus intercept
cusp_model.beta: linear in three frozen splitting-factor controls plus intercept

evaluation.paired_uncertainty: stationary/circular block bootstrap with 12-month blocks, 4000 deterministic resamples
evaluation.simultaneous_control: max-stat across Brier and log-loss improvements and both validation/lockbox splits

forbidden: promote historical fit as live direction
substitute unavailable credit/breadth data after seeing result

observable_features.normalization: means/stds estimated on training only and frozen

primary_dataset.reason: long fixed bundled history with SPX, valuation, inflation, rates, gold and DXY; no post-outcome source substitution

promotion_gate: cusp structural predictive density beats both linear and quadratic smooth density on validation and lockbox
baseline+cusp Brier and log-loss improvements are positive on validation and lockbox
simultaneous adjusted 95% lower bound is above zero
baseline+cusp is not worse than smooth nonlinear challenger on Brier and log loss in either split
ECE does not worsen by more than 0.01 in either split
equal-burden cluster event recall is not lower than baseline in either split
placebo shuffled alpha/beta and future-shift controls do not pass
no result may change live_decision_weight or capital permission without separate matured prospective receipt

secondary_dataset.use: breadth sensitivity only; cannot promote primary claim because sample is short and survivorship-prone

state.normalization: divide by trailing 12-month RMS return using only t-1 and earlier observations

target.primary: minimum simple return from current month-end SPX to any of next 6 month-ends <= -10%
